---
name: Feature request
description: Suggest a new feature or improvement for AutoDMX
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## 🚀 Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation / Problem

What problem does this solve? Why is it important? Is your workflow blocked without it?

## 📝 Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution in detail. How would it work? What would the user experience look like?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is the proposed solution better?

## 🎨 Mockups / Examples

Add mockups, diagrams, or example code/queries if helpful.

## 📊 Impact

- **Who benefits?** (e.g. all users, self-hosters, agencies)
- **Effort estimate:** (rough — small, medium, large)
- **Breaking change?** (yes / no)

## 🔍 Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or related issues/PRs.

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] I have searched [existing issues](https://github.com/Qaxlabs/AutoDMX/issues) for this request
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] I am willing to [submit a PR](../CONTRIBUTING.md#development-workflow) for this feature
